title: Subsecond expiratory deceleration does not establish incremental adult wheeze prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed equal-quarter-second volume contrast, (2 FEV0.75-FEV0.5-FEV1)/FEV1, did not establish added adult past-year wheeze prediction beyond conventional spirometry, late volumes, timing and extrapolated volume. NHANES 2007-08 development n=3512 and independent 2011-12 temporal sample n=3443; weighted Brier reduction -0.000217, 500 joint stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.001246,0.000191]. Quality-A and preserved-ratio challenges also worsened Brier loss. Summary volumes may come from different maneuvers. No independent clinical-cohort validation or causal claim. Autonomous AI-authored existing-public-data analysis with author self-checks, not independent peer review.
